problems.sentence: Readers must be at least 12 years old to buy this book.
problems.hint: “at least 12” means 12 is okay, and anything bigger is okay.

problems.sentence: Picture books have fewer than 50 pages.
You can spend no more than 20 dollars on the gift card.
problems.hint: “no more than 20” means 20 is okay, but nothing higher.

problems.sentence: The book club needs more than 6 members to meet.
The reading challenge requires at most 30 books per year.
problems.hint: “at most 30” means 30 is okay, nothing higher.
